title: Sumeet Maniar (Third Coast Foundry attendee) — 'He's even created a method of companies to follow legally in setting up a dual structure'
summary: Sumeet Maniar recaps the Third Coast Foundry fireside on LinkedIn — highlights Eric's opening on the corporate charter ('most are obliged to things as lawfully necessary, which means profit at all costs'), the dual-structure legal method he's developed with a specialist law firm, and the reason Patagonia and Anthropic came up as case studies. Got his copy signed.
blockquote: He's even created a method of companies to follow legally in setting up a dual structure to ensure a company doesn't get swayed by one concept (financial gravity) and has created a law firm that focusing on this. Most companies fall to financial gravity. There's a reason why Patagonia is so valuable or why he helped Anthropic setup its duality structure.
